What the garage does

From the garage’s Facebook page and from what customers describe on Google.

Diagnostics and electrics

Customers describe an engine management fault found and fixed while they waited, an airbag warning traced to the clock spring and an alternator replaced after a breakdown on the highway.

Service and oil change

Oil changes, air and cabin filters and the regular service come up most often in the reviews. One customer notes that the whole engine bay was cleaned as part of the service.

Brakes and suspension

Brakes, brake pads, steering and suspension are listed in several reviews. One customer booked a front brake pad change and the car was ready in no time.

Air conditioning and more

On Facebook the garage offers maintenance and repair of the car’s air conditioning. Reviews also mention transmission repair and the hydraulic fluid of a convertible soft top.

From the workshop

Photos from the garage’s own Facebook page and Google listing.

How a visit works

Taken from what customers describe in their Google reviews.

Explained in plain words

Several customers write that everything was explained clearly, even to people who know nothing about cars. One was shown the parts that were used, another was given options for the repair.

A second opinion

One customer came for a second opinion and writes that it saved more than €1,500 of unnecessary repairs another mechanic had recommended.

Check before you buy

For a last-minute inspection before buying a used car, the garage made time on short notice and found the car was not roadworthy.

A garage since 2023

The year 2023 is on the garage’s own logo, the shield with the car outline and the palm trees that also hangs on the workshop wall. The hall on Andrea Souroukli Street in Larnaca has several lifts. Customers write that they bring different makes and that the team can handle all of them, and several reviews point out that English is spoken well.
